o.text: From Persian بها; compare also Persian بها پیشی (“money advanced, prepayment”).
Borrowed from Classical Persian بَادِمْجَان (bādimjān), form of بَادِنْجَان (bādinjān).
Borrowed from Arabic قِسْمًا (qisman), adverbial accusative of قِسْم (qism). By surface analysis, qisim + -ən.
